SOCIAL STUDIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #16
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Population Growth in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   B. Treat Population Growth in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Explain Population Growth in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Population Growth in Africa never happens in Kenya.

2. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Name the president
   D. Measure rainfall only
